question_text: A group of farmers in Nueva Ecija are demanding that the government distribute to them the unused agricultural lands of a large hacienda. Under Article XIII of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following best describes the state's mandate?

options.text: The state has no obligation to distribute private agricultural lands because property rights are inviolable.
The state shall promote agrarian reform and distribute lands to farmers, subject to just compensation to landowners.
The state may distribute lands only if the landowners voluntarily offer them for sale.
The state shall confiscate all large agricultural estates without compensation and distribute them to farmers.
